notes: Confirmed exact rodata strings CrossPlay at 0x7001d58faf and allow at 0x7001d0530b against MLBTS/game/exefs/main. Body checks the CrossPlay property and allow value, builds an event payload, writes the allow field, then returns the built result. The available caller tail-calls it after processing event-related values.

The body initializes the destination state, dispatches over input entries, selects both frontend/servers_local.xml (verified at guest address 0x7001cf3822) and frontend/servers.xml (0x7001d1950f), invokes the configuration parser for each, then copies parsed fields into the destination. This supports loading frontend server configuration. No direct caller was found in generated main C.

Confirmed CURRENT_PLAYER at guest address 0x7001d50068 and player_id at 0x7001d44742. The body retrieves the current-player property, extracts player_id, and writes the resolved value to the global current-player slot. Available caller tail-calls this helper as part of the same player-state flow.

Confirmed DD_LINEUP_DATA at guest address 0x7001d21e84 and position at 0x7001d17fbb. The body validates context status, obtains the lineup array, reads the requested position, bounds-checks/indexes the 8-byte entries, resolves the selected record, and updates context state only on success. No direct caller was found in generated main C.

The body iterates candidate arena-card indices, formats ARENACARD%d (format string at 0x7001cb6652) and checks the selected record's poofed property (0x7001c4219a). A poofed result is rejected/continued; an accepted candidate updates the context. This directly supports the proposed purpose. No direct caller was found in generated main C.

The body evaluates status/context gates and directly queries ignoreCPURosterControl at verified guest address 0x7001c4ba02; the returned status branches determine whether control is ignored. CPURosterControl itself is not directly looked up in this routine, but the proposed name is specifically tied to the ignore key and remains supported. No direct caller was found in generated main C.

The body formats CARD%u using verified string address 0x7001ccbeb6, reads the selected record's tbFlags property at 0x7001c6ee9c, compares those bits with the context masks, updates the relevant card flag byte, and stores the adjusted property. This supports the update_card_tb_flags label. No direct caller was found in generated main C.

Confirmed AVAILABLE_RAIDS at guest address 0x7001d106a8 and raid at 0x7001c41cdb. The body retrieves the raid list, bounds-checks the requested entry, resolves its raid value, then compares the candidate's numeric identifier/status to the resolved value and returns a boolean. This supports the availability predicate. No direct caller was found in generated main C.
